type Chunk = Chunk
type Config struct{APIKey string; BaseURL string; OrgID string; Timeout time.Duration; Retries int; RetryBackoff time.Duration; Headers map[string]string; Store bool; ServiceTier string; OmitTemperature bool; HTTPClient *http.Client; Endpoint *EndpointPolicy; Models Models}
type Decider interface{DecisionLimits() schemaflux.DecisionLimits}
func DeclareRoute(provider string, model string, regions []string, retentionDays int)
type EndpointPolicy struct{Schemes []string; Hosts []string; AllowPrivate bool}
type Factory func(cfg Config) (schemaflux.Provider, error)
type Models struct{Smart string; Fast string; Quick string}
func Names() []string
func New(name string, cfg Config) (schemaflux.Provider, error)
func OpenAICompatible(name string, baseURL string, cfg Config) (schemaflux.Provider, error)
func Register(name string, f Factory) error
func RegisterKeyless(name string, f Factory) error
type Retrier interface{RetryPolicy() (retries int, backoff time.Duration)}
type Streamer interface{Stream(ctx context.Context, req schemaflux.Request) iter.Seq2[schemaflux.Chunk, error]}
type Unwrapper interface{Unwrap() schemaflux.Provider}
type Warmer interface{Warm(ctx context.Context) error}
